scenes.narration: Your entity describes the data. A service projection exposes it. Let's use this tiny inventory app.
Define Products with an ID, title, and stock. The project already includes three sample rows, so we can get moving.
Now expose Products through InventoryService. That's the API. This demo is read-only, so a create request gets rejected.
Run npm run demo. Open the local Products URL and filter for stock above zero. The keyboard and dock come back.
That's a real local OData version four endpoint with sample results. Deployment and authentication come later.
Try the checked-in project and its tests. Which entity would you expose first?
